descriptions: This Arab West Report Interview Documentation Project dataset contains 4 audio recordings covering the state visit of Dutch Queen Beatrix and her husband Prince Claus to Egypt in 1997
The languages of the interviews are German and Dutch. The summaries and metadata of the audio recordings are provided in English.
